svg.text: Systolic-array GEMM tile: dataflow + Python-orchestrated tiling
rtl/systolic_array.v (8x8, output-stationary) driven by tb/mnist/test_mnist.py's feed_wave / compute_nblock
PANEL A -- one 8x8x8 wave (22 cycles = 3N-2, N=8)
A rows enter west -- row i's real data starts at cycle t=i (zero before)
B cols enter north -- col j's
real data starts at cycle t=j
the sum stays in this cell --
shaded band: the diagonal wavefront where real (non-zero-padded) data from both edges
meets at a given cycle -- sweeps corner to corner over all 22 cycles (docs/decisions.md)
feed_wave() x8, no reset between -- accumulator keeps summing (same N-block)
Between N-blocks: compute_nblock() calls reset_dut() first -- fresh accumulators for
different output columns, not a continuation of the previous sum.
Same physical 8x8 tile, reused 40x total per batch-of-8 pass -- no hardware change between waves.
